title: cordyline thomsonii
intro: Cordyline thomsonii, commonly known as the New Zealand cabbage tree or harakeke, is a type of evergreen plant that belongs to the Asparagaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Cordyline thomsonii include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against infections, reduce pain and swelling, and neutralize free radicals in the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
